insights.claim: Across covered ZCTAs, the national two-party 2020 margin is D+4.49 (positive = more Democratic).
insights.method_note: Vote-weighted two-party margin over covered ZCTAs; fractional disaggregated votes.

insights.claim: The most-deprived ADI tenth averages 18.6 points more Republican than the least-deprived tenth.
insights.method_note: Population-weighted ADI national-rank decile means; ecological, not causal.

insights.claim: Across ZCTAs, 2020 margin is most associated with population density (Spearman rho=0.608, n=30,689).
insights.method_note: Spearman rank correlation; place-level association only.

insights.claim: Most Democratic: 39217 (Hinds County, MS) at +97.4 points; most republican: 79061 (Wheeler County, TX) at -96.8.
insights.method_note: Extreme ZCTA values among places with at least 250 residents.

insights.claim: About 155 million people live in landslide ZCTAs (absolute margin of 30+ points).
insights.method_note: Population in ZCTAs where the absolute value is 30 points or more.
